title: HDL Counter
text: Free-running or count-limited hardware counter, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Counter type} sets Counter behavior Free; {Initial value} sets the counter value after reset, {Step value}, {Count to value} sets the threshold count value, {Count from} sets the criteria for count from value Initial, {Count from value} sets the initial value to count, {Local reset port} sets the local port to reset counter, {Load ports} sets the port for load value, {Count enable port} sets the port to enable counting, {Count direction port} sets the port for count direction, {Count hit output port} sets the port for count limit, {Counter output data is} sets the output data type, {Word length} sets the counter word length, {Fraction length} sets the counter fraction length and {Sample time} sets the counter sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Counter type
params.values: Counter behavior Free running (default) | Count limited | Modulo

params.name: Count from
params.values: Criteria for count from value Initial value (default) | Specify

params.name: Local reset port
params.values: Local port to reset counter off (default) | on

params.name: Load ports
params.values: Port for load value off (default) | on

params.name: Count enable port
params.values: Port to enable counting off (default) | on

params.name: Count direction port
params.values: Port for count direction off (default) | on

params.name: Count hit output port
params.values: Port for count limit off (default) | on

params.name: Counter output data is
params.values: Output data type signedness Unsigned (default) | Signed
